Site match: PDK is the former NAS Atlanta (page does not say so; established by the batch note).

Page: 'Sky Harbour, a home-based operator for business aircraft at DeKalb-Peachtree Airport (PDK)'. The AvWeb 'Sky Harbour Group' wording was not checked here; summary correctly says entity not confirmed.

Town hall Tue Dec 9 on the approved $45M hangar expansion; concerns 'noise and environmental pollution'; Terry 'plans to propose' a moratorium on new hangar development until master plan updated, plus FAA night-flight ban.
